sources.note: Main homepage. Describes Careexpand as 'the operating system for continuity of care.' Claims 20,000+ users. Three product tiers: Telemedicine, Continuity of Care, Full Practice Management.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists certified product version v2024.11.0, pricing tiers ($49/$149/$249 per provider/month), Change Healthcare add-on ($65/mo), certified CQMs (pediatric weight counseling, diabetes HbA1c), and third-party dependencies (CHC-Optum Clinician, Auth0).
Platform overview page. Details telemedicine, EHR with AI-generated coding metatags, e-prescription/lab orders, continuity of care coordination, referral management, and scheduling features.
Full Practice Management product page. Describes clinical documentation, e-prescribing, lab integration, scheduling, billing, CQM reporting, care coordination, and decision support.
About page. Company founded 2016 in Plano, TX. Timeline: 2016 founded, 2017 MVP, 2018 funding, 2019 beta, 2022 major update, 2024 full-suite launch. Lists 16 team members including CEO Javier Vinals.
Clinic use case page. Describes patient portal, automated clinical documentation, referral management, and system integration capabilities for clinic workflows.
Doctor use case page. Emphasizes unified scheduling calendar, administrative automation (scheduling, billing, coding), patient communication, and telemedicine delivery.
RPM page. Mentions device delivery/configuration, clinical monitoring and alerts, chronic condition tracking. Lacks specifics on supported devices or health metrics.

Enterprise page. Targets health systems, payers, provider networks, and retail/DTC brands. Describes HIPAA/SOC2 compliance, role-based access, API/HL7/FHIR connectors, AI-powered patient journey orchestration.
ZoomInfo company profile. Lists 1-10 employees, Dallas TX headquarters. Confirms startup-stage company size.
Crunchbase listing found in search results. Confirms CEO Javier Vinals and company existence.
